Changes in 0.9.3:
- MARKER layout now uses aligned rows, so AUTO PEAK is fully visible.
- Menu tab highlight uses an exact-size box and no longer covers the divider.
- CARRIER band choices include Chinese operator and band names.
- Connection diagnostics from 0.9.2 are included: auto USB authorization, clearer failures, and red error text.

Notes:
- Debug certificate; not suitable for Play Store publishing.
- Hardware behavior depends on TinySA firmware and OEM USB implementation.
